title: Situation not confidently identified

quotableLine.en: May I know your name and buckle number, and what this is regarding?
quotableLine.hi: क्या मैं आपका नाम और बकल नंबर जान सकता हूँ, और यह किस बारे में है?

doNotSay: Any legal section you are not certain of.
documentNow: The officer's name and buckle number, the location, and the time.

options.label: Ask for the officer's name and buckle number.
options.rationale: Always available, never confrontational, and it is the fact most often missing later.

options.label: Comply with lawful instructions and keep your hands visible.
options.rationale: Nothing you gain by arguing outweighs what you lose if this escalates.

options.label: Keep the session recording and let it upload.
options.rationale: The record is worth more than any argument made at the roadside.

options.label: Send the trusted-contact alert.
options.rationale: Someone knowing where you are costs nothing.

verification.notes: Universal safe actions. Must be counsel-reviewed for escalation risk before any use.

_note: PRD Design Principle 3 — this is what the engine says when it is not confident. It contains no section numbers by design.
